description: This file defines internal structures, functions, and classes for handling civil time representations, including normalization, arithmetic, comparison, and weekday calculations, within the Abseil C++ library's time internal namespace.

classes.name: civil_time
classes.description: Template class representing civil time with different alignments (year, month, day, hour, minute, second). Provides arithmetic, comparison, and hashing functionalities.

methods.name: operator+
methods.description: Adds a duration (diff_t) to a civil_time object.

methods.name: operator-
methods.description: Subtracts a duration (diff_t) or another civil_time from a civil_time object.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Checks equality between two civil_time objects.

methods.name: get_weekday
methods.description: Calculates the weekday for a given civil_second.

methods.name: next_weekday
methods.description: Finds the next civil_day matching a specified weekday.

methods.name: prev_weekday
methods.description: Finds the previous civil_day matching a specified weekday.
